facts.fact: Erica 突访（job interview：产科岗、面得不错）——Dale 用 seasoned carny 手法向她推销 Royal Doulton 瓷偶；记忆机制：他活在大一暑假返家那一年、把 Roddie 误作 teenaged Kyle。
facts.anchor: It continued to amaze me that he couldn’t remember how to flush a toilet but knew how to draw in a customer like a seasoned carny.

facts.fact: 父亲努力安放 Erica 的身份（问过几次、仍只能归档进母亲去世前那个夏天）；客套问 How are your parents?——她与母亲断来往（hard-earned 的 boundary），微笑含糊带过。
facts.anchor: I could hear the vagueness in Dad’s voice as he tried to place her.

facts.fact: 咖啡角对坐：她自陈 thinking about you a lot、为结局难受；他敬她的设界能力；胸口被千万蚂蚁咀嚼的体感（Are we? 的反问砸下来）——他分神想：Meg 是不是正看着这边。
facts.anchor: I don’t blame you for setting boundaries.” Her ability to do so was hard-earned.

facts.fact: 关系验尸报告：和平同居靠忙碌撑着而非兼容——浪头一来就散架；自测题（If I had missed her, I would have been texting her all this time）答案是否定的；买咖啡的心虚：像在「别处已有承诺」时赴约。
facts.anchor: The truth was, our ability to cohabit peacefully had more to do with the fact that we’d had demanding jobs, and less to do with our compatibility.

facts.fact: 终审判决：all-consuming with Dad、no bandwidth——同时放行她的搬家（喜欢岛和这份工作就去）；Ali 端咖啡顺口一句「I assume this is for Meg?」（给 Meg 的麦芬多加了黄油）——Erica 僵住：Who's Meg?Erica stiffened. “Who’s Meg?” || 章末悬念：Ali 的「这袋是给 Meg 的？」（麦芬多加了黄油）让 Erica 当场 stiffened——Who’s Meg? 三词收章。
facts.anchor: But for me, things are all-consuming with Dad. I don’t have the bandwidth for a relationship.
